chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan and Fadalah, from Rifa'ah ibn Musa, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about one performing tamattu' who cannot find a sacrificial offering. He said: He fasts one day before al-Tarwiyah, the day of al-Tarwiyah, and the day of 'Arafah. I said: What if he arrived on the day of al-Tarwiyah and then went out to 'Arafat? He said: He fasts three days after the day of al-nafr, one day after al-Tarwiyah and the day of al-nafr.

I said: What if his camel-driver does not stay for him? He said: He fasts on the day of al-Hasbah and two days after it. I said: Does he fast while he is traveling? He said: Yes. Is he not traveling on the day of 'Arafah?
For Allah, Exalted is He, says: “three days during the hajj.”
He said: I said: May Allah عزّ وجلّ honor you, Allah, Exalted is He, says: in Dhu al-Hijjah? Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام said: And we, the Ahl al-Bayt, say: in Dhu al-Hijjah.

key_terms.فِي ٱلْحَجِّ: during the hajj, indicating the time frame of the prescribed fasting
key_terms.مُسَافِرٌ: a traveler, here regarding the permissibility of fasting in travel
key_terms.هَدْيًا: a sacrificial offering required in this hajj context
key_terms.ٱلتَّرْوِيَةِ: the eighth day of Dhu al-Hijjah
key_terms.ٱلنَّفْرِ: the day of departure from Mina
key_terms.ٱلْحَصْبَةِ: the day associated with al-Hasbah after the rites

ai.seo_question: How should a pilgrim performing tamattu' fast if he cannot find the hady during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith explains the ruling for a pilgrim performing hajj al-tamattu' who cannot find a sacrificial offering, specifying how and when the required three fasts may be observed. It also clarifies that these fasts may be performed while traveling and connects the ruling to the Qur'anic phrase about fasting during the hajj, with an explicit statement from Ahl al-Bayt عليهم السلام regarding its timing in Dhu al-Hijjah.
